About Bitcoin

Bitcoin is the first decentralized cryptocurrency, launched in 2009 by the pseudonymous Satoshi Nakamoto. It runs on a proof-of-work blockchain with a fixed maximum supply of 21 million coins.

Where this BTC price comes from

The price above updates live in your browser from Coinbase (BTC-USD), Binance (BTC/USDT) and Kraken (BTC/USD), and the badge shows which exchange reported the latest trade.
